description: Neutral baseline; clear ordinary phrasing, no emotional or stylistic overlay
style_instructions: Write in clear, ordinary language. Complete sentences, standard grammar, no emotional urgency, no special formatting. The user is simply stating their question or problem. Word budget: 10-30 words.

description: Relaxed, complete sentences, has time, may add background context
style_instructions: The user is at home with time to spare. Write in complete, well-formed sentences. May include background context or explanation. No urgency, clear and organized phrasing. Word budget: 15-35 words.

description: Anxious and urgent; fears losing money or the account; pleads for immediate help
style_instructions: The user is panicked about potential fraud or loss. Urgent, emotional tone. Use phrases like 'please help', 'now', 'emergency'. May have minor grammar issues due to haste. No greetings, straight to the problem. Word budget: 10-30 words.

description: Frustrated; already waited or contacted support before; demands resolution
style_instructions: The user is angry and frustrated. Already tried to resolve this. Demands action. Short, clipped sentences. May use caps for emphasis. Expresses dissatisfaction with delay or previous lack of help. Word budget: 10-30 words.

description: Describes screens/menus that don't match what they see; uncertain, questioning wording
style_instructions: The user is confused and uncertain. Describes what they see but it doesn't make sense. Questions terminology or menu options. 'Where do I find', 'I don't see', 'what do you mean'. Uncertain, hesitant tone. Word budget: 15-40 words.

description: Hurried; typos, dropped words, lowercase, missing punctuation; MUST contain visible typos
style_instructions: The user is typing very quickly. Expect typos, missing vowels, dropped words, inconsistent capitalization (mostly lowercase), missing punctuation at ends of sentences. Run-on sentences. Abbreviations. 'pls', 'thx', 'u' for 'you'. MUST include 2+ realistic typos (missing vowels, transposed letters, dropped words). Word budget: 8-25 words.

description: Terse, minimal words, imperative; mid-task (checkout, ATM, airport, delivery)
style_instructions: The user is in the middle of something time-sensitive (checkout, ATM line, boarding). Minimal words. Imperative mood. No greetings. Just the problem, now. 'help me', 'fix this', 'can't access'. Terse and direct. Word budget: 5-18 words.

description: Dictated run-on text; little or odd punctuation, filler words, spoken rhythm
style_instructions: Voice-to-text output. Run-on sentences with minimal or odd punctuation (commas where periods should be). Filler words like 'um', 'uh', 'like'. Conversational rhythm. May include transcription errors like 'their' for 'they're' or 'hear' for 'here'. Word budget: 20-45 words.

description: Mentions failing uploads/loading/retries; asks what to do with a bad connection
style_instructions: The user is experiencing connectivity issues. Mentions things not loading, uploads failing, connection dropping, 'retry', 'timeout', 'stuck at loading'. Asks what to do when connection is poor or if action will complete despite error. Word budget: 12-35 words.

description: Imprecise problem description; generic or wrong terminology; symptoms only, no feature names
style_instructions: The user is describing symptoms but doesn't know the right terminology. Uses generic or incorrect words for features. 'the thing', 'that button', 'my money disappeared', 'charged twice'. No technical terms. Vague about what exactly happened or what feature is involved. Word budget: 8-25 words.
